pokedexEntries.rb: It uses its whiskers to maintain its balance. It apparently slows down if they are cut off.

pokedexEntries.ye: Its hind feet are webbed. They act as flippers, so it can swim in rivers and hunt for prey.

pokedexEntries.go: Gnaws on anything with its tough fangs. It can even topple concrete buildings by gnawing on them.

pokedexEntries.si: Its whiskers help it to maintain balance. Its fangs never stop growing, so it gnaws to pare them down.

pokedexEntries.cr: The webs on its hind legs enable it to cross rivers. It searches wide areas for food.

pokedexEntries.rs: RATICATE’s sturdy fangs grow steadily. To keep them ground down, it gnaws on rocks and logs. It may even chew on the walls of houses.

pokedexEntries.fr: Its rear feet have three toes each. They are webbed, enabling it to swim across rivers.

pokedexEntries.lg: It uses its whiskers to maintain its balance. It apparently slows down if they are cut off.

pokedexEntries.em: A RATICATE’s sturdy fangs grow steadily. To keep them ground down, it gnaws on rocks and logs. It may even chew on the walls of houses.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It whittles its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder walls.

pokedexEntries.hg: Gnaws on anything with its tough fangs. It can even topple concrete buildings by gnawing on them.

pokedexEntries.ss: Its whiskers help it to maintain balance. Its fangs never stop growing, so it gnaws to pare them down.

pokedexEntries.bw: It whittles its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder walls.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: With its long fangs, this surprisingly violent Pokémon can gnaw away even thick concrete with ease.

pokedexEntries.x: It whittles its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder walls.

pokedexEntries.y: The webs on its hind legs enable it to cross rivers. It searches wide areas for food.

pokedexEntries.oras: Raticate’s sturdy fangs grow steadily. To keep them ground down, it gnaws on rocks and logs. It may even chew on the walls of houses.

pokedexEntries.su: Its hind feet are webbed, so it’s a strong swimmer. It can cross rivers and sometimes even oceans.

pokedexEntries.mo: Its disposition is far more violent than its looks would suggest. Don’t let your hand get too close to its face, as it could bite your hand clean off.

pokedexEntries.us: People say that it fled from its enemies by using its small webbed hind feet to swim from island to island in Alola.

pokedexEntries.um: Its whiskers are essential for maintaining its balance. No matter how friendly you are, it will get angry and bite you if you touch its whiskers.

pokedexEntries.lgpe: Its hind feet are webbed. They act as flippers, so it can swim in rivers and hunt for prey.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: It whittles down its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder block walls.
